description: This PHP source file manages the administrative settings for the SugarFeed module within the SuiteCRM environment. It handles retrieving and updating configuration settings via web requests, including enabling/disabling feeds for different modules, processing record deletions, and rendering the settings interface with Smarty templates.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine instance used to render the admin settings page.

methods.name: retrieveSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration settings for the admin object.

methods.name: saveSetting
methods.description: Saves a configuration setting for a specified category and name.

methods.name: flushBackendCache
methods.description: Clears the backend cache related to SugarFeed.
